Game Overview

At its heart, Cat Mart is a management game about create your feline empire in Cat Mart, where you manage a cat-themed supermarket with cute cat workers and customers. Balance operations, stock supplies wisely, and expand your business for a thriving city. The whimsical world of Cat Mart offers endless delight as you build the purrrfect retail success.

Playing Cat Mart comes down to a simple loop. Create your feline empire in Cat Mart, where you manage a cat-themed supermarket with cute cat workers and customers.
